text:
alex: Quick Q: where do I look for per-pool autoscale behavior (graphs + raw signals) for the dedicated pools? trying to debug a scale/no-scale on eu-west-1-prod.
maria: console -> Observability -> Pools -> Dedicated Pools -> select pool. there's a 'scaling' tab with desired/actual replicas, queue length, and GPU util. also link to Grafana + Prometheus queries.
jevon: If you want raw PromQL use: ```avg by (pool) (redwood_pool_node_gpu_utilization{pool="eu-west-1-prod"})``` and ```sum by (pool) (redwood_pool_request_queue_length{pool="eu-west-1-prod"})```
alex: nice — is there a single place that shows autoscaler decisions? e.g. desired_replicas vs last_scale_reason
infra-bot: autoscaler events: /grafana/annotations?panelId=23&var-pool=eu-west-1-prod, or use prometheus metric `redwood_autoscaler_events_total{pool="eu-west-1-prod"}` which includes labels `reason` and `delta_replicas`
maria: we also emit `redwood_autoscaler_desired_replicas` and `redwood_autoscaler_last_evaluation{pool=...}`. look at the 'scaling timeline' panel.
alex: thanks — we're seeing GPU util ~65% but queue length spikes then no scale. hypothesis: prefix KV cache causing bursts? where to check cache hit rate?
jevon: KV cache metric: `redwood_pool_kv_cache_hit_ratio{pool="eu-west-1-prod"}`. if hit ratio drops under ~0.5 during bursts, you'll see tail latency increase but util stays medium. Also check `redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total`.
maria: also check token-level batching: `redwood_batch_size_avg{pool=...}`. autoscaler uses a composite saturation signal — not just GPU util. latency and queue length matter.
alex: how should we tune alerts? current cpu/gpu util alerts were noisy.
sre-oncall: recommendations we've used: alert when `queue_length > 50` for 2m OR `gpu_util > 85%` for 5m. add mute on deploys. For scale-up/no-scale incidents add a low-priority alert on `autoscaler_events_total` with `reason="failed_scale"` so we can catch failures.
jevon: if you want a quick composite score: ```(avg_gpu_util*0.6) + (min(1,queue_length/100)*40) + (1 - kv_hit_ratio)*100``` normalize as needed — we expose `redwood_pool_saturation_score` for some pools, check it.
alex: :thumbsup: I'll pull the graphs and post back. can someone paste the direct grafana link for eu-west-1-prod panel?
maria: here's a direct: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/dedicated?var-pool=eu-west-1-prod&panelId=23
alex: posting findings in #eng-platform later. thanks all.
